description_en: Queries the configuration of a specified listener by calling the DescribeListener operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeListener接口查询指定监听的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun ga describe-listener --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --listener-id lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeListener

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the listener to query
parameters.name: listener_id

AcceleratorId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance ID

AclType.description_en:
The type of access control:
white: Only requests from IP addresses or CIDR blocks in the selected access control policy group are forwarded. Whitelists are applicable to scenarios in which an application allows access only from specific IP addresses. Enabling a whitelist poses some risks. After a whitelist is enabled, only the IP addresses in the whitelist can access the Global Accelerator listener. If a whitelist is enabled but no IP address is added to the access control policy group, the Global Accelerator listener does not forward any requests.
black: All requests from IP addresses or CIDR blocks in the selected access control policy group are blocked. Blacklists are applicable to scenarios in which an application denies access only from specific IP addresses. If a blacklist is enabled but no IP address is added to the access control policy group, the Global Accelerator listener forwards all requests.

This parameter is returned only when the value of the Status parameter is on
AclType.description_zh:
访问控制类型：
white：仅转发来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段的请求，白名单适用于应用只允许特定IP访问的场景。设置白名单存在一定业务风险。一旦设置白名单，就只有白名单中的IP可以访问全球加速监听。如果开启了白名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则全球加速监听不会转发请求。
black：来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段的所有请求都不会转发，黑名单适用于应用只限制某些特定IP访问的场景。如果开启了黑名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则全球加速监听会转发全部请求。

当Status参数的值为on时，返回该项

FromPort.description_en:
The first port in the range of ports used by the backend server to accept requests.

This parameter is returned only when the listener protocol is HTTPS and the listening port is the same as the port on which the backend service is provided
FromPort.description_zh:
后端服务器接收请求的起始端口。

当您的监听协议为HTTPS，且监听的端口和后端服务器提供服务的端口一致时才会返回该项

ToPort.description_en: The last port in the range of ports used by the backend server to accept requests
ToPort.description_zh: 后端服务器接收请求的结束端口

Type.description_en:
The certificate type.

Currently, only Server (server certificate) is supported
Type.description_zh:
证书类型。

目前，仅支持返回Server（服务端证书）

ClientAffinity.description_en:
The client affinity.

If NONE is returned, client affinity is not maintained. Connections from the same client are not always directed to the same endpoint.

If SOURCE_IP is returned, client affinity is maintained. When a client accesses a stateful application, all requests from the same client can be directed to the same endpoint, regardless of the source port and protocol
ClientAffinity.description_zh:
客户端亲和性。

返回为NONE时：不保持客户端亲和性，即不能确保来自同一客户端的连接请求始终定向到同一终端节点。

返回为SOURCE_IP时，保持客户端亲和性。即客户端访问有状态的应用程序时，可以将来自同一客户端的所有请求都定向到同一终端节点，而不考虑源端口和协议

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the listener was created. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建监听的时间戳。单位：毫秒

HttpVersion.description_en:
The maximum version of the HTTP protocol. Valid values:
http3: HTTP/3.
http2: HTTP/2.
http1.1: HTTP/1.1.
Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter
HttpVersion.description_zh:
HTTP协议的最大版本，取值：
http3：HTTP/3。
http2：HTTP/2。
http1.1：HTTP/1.1。
仅HTTPS监听支持此参数

IdleTimeout.description_en: The idle connection timeout period. Unit: seconds
IdleTimeout.description_zh: 连接空闲超时时间。单位：秒

FromPort.description_en: The first listening port of the port range used to receive requests and forward them to endpoints
FromPort.description_zh: 用来接收请求并向终端节点进行转发的起始监听端口

ToPort.description_en: The last listening port of the port range used to receive requests and forward them to endpoints
ToPort.description_zh: 用来接收请求并向终端节点进行转发的结束监听端口

Protocol.description_en:
The network transmission protocol type of the listener.
TCP: TCP protocol.
UDP: UDP protocol.
HTTP: HTTP protocol.
HTTPS: HTTPS protocol
Protocol.description_zh:
监听的网络传输协议类型。
TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议。
HTTP：HTTP协议。
HTTPS：HTTPS协议

ProxyProtocol.description_en:
Indicates whether the client IP address preservation feature is enabled.
true: The client IP address preservation feature is enabled. After this feature is enabled, backend services can view the originating IP addresses of clients.
false: The client IP address preservation feature is disabled
ProxyProtocol.description_zh:
是否开启了保持客户端源IP功能。
true：开启了保持客户端源IP功能。开启后，支持后端服务查看客户端的原始IP地址。
false：未开启保持客户端源IP功能

RelatedAcls.description_en: The information about the access control policy group associated with the listener
RelatedAcls.description_zh: 监听绑定的访问控制策略组信息

items.description_en: The information about the access control policy group associated with the listener
items.description_zh: 监听绑定的访问控制策略组信息

AclId.description_en: The ID of the access control policy group associated with the listener
AclId.description_zh: 监听绑定的访问策略组ID

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the access control feature is enabled.

Associated: Enabled
Status.description_zh:
是否开启了访问控制功能。

Associated：已开启

RequestTimeout.description_en:
The HTTP/HTTPS connection request timeout period. Unit: seconds.
This parameter is valid only for listeners whose Protocol (network transmission protocol type) is HTTP or HTTPS. If the backend server does not return a response within the timeout period, Global Accelerator stops waiting and returns an HTTP 504 error code to the client
RequestTimeout.description_zh:
HTTP/HTTPS的连接请求超时时间。单位：秒。
仅对Protocol（网络传输协议类型）为HTTP或HTTPS的监听有效。如果在超时时间内后端服务器一直没有响应，全球加速将放弃等待，并给客户端返回HTTP 504错误码

SecurityPolicyId.description_en:
The TLS security policy instance ID.

tls_cipher_policy_1_0

    - Supported TLS versions: TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1, and TLSv1.2.

    - Supported encryption algorithm suites: ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384, AES128-GCM-SHA256, AES256-GCM-SHA384, AES128-SHA256, AES256-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA, AES128-SHA, AES256-SHA, and DES-CBC3-SHA.

tls_cipher_policy_1_1

    - Supported TLS versions: TLSv1.1 and TLSv1.2.

    - Supported encryption algorithm suites: ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384, AES128-GCM-SHA256, AES256-GCM-SHA384, AES128-SHA256, AES256-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA, AES128-SHA, AES256-SHA, and DES-CBC3-SHA.

tls_cipher_policy_1_2

    - Supported TLS versions: TLSv1.2.

    - Supported encryption algorithm suites: ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384, AES128-GCM-SHA256, AES256-GCM-SHA384, AES128-SHA256, AES256-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA, AES128-SHA, AES256-SHA, and DES-CBC3-SHA.

tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict

    - Supported TLS versions: TLSv1.2.

    - Supported encryption algorithm suites: ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA, and ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA.

tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict_with_1_3

    - Supported TLS versions: TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3.

    - Supported encryption algorithm suites: TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256, TLS_AES_128_CCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_128_CCM_8_SHA256, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA, ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA, and ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA.

Only HTTPS listeners support this parameter

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service that manages the managed instance.
This parameter is valid only when the ServiceManaged parameter is set to True
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。
仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is managed. Valid values:
true: The instance is managed.
false: The instance is not managed
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：
true：是托管实例。
false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The list of action policies that the user can execute on the managed instance.
This parameter is valid only when the ServiceManaged parameter is set to True.
When the instance is in the managed state, user operations on the instance are restricted, and certain operations are prohibited
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。
仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_en: The list of action policies that the user can execute on the managed instance
items.description_zh: 用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the managed policy action. Valid values:
Create: Creates an instance.
Update: Updates the current instance.
Delete: Deletes the current instance.
Associate: References or is referenced by the current instance.
UserUnmanaged: Unmanages the instance.
CreateChild: Creates a child resource under the current instance
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称，取值：
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The child resource type. Valid values:
Listener: listener resource.
IpSet: acceleration region resource.
EndpointGroup: endpoint group resource.
ForwardingRule: forwarding rule resource.
Endpoint: endpoint resource.
EndpointGroupDestination: protocol mapping resource of the endpoint group under a custom routing listener.
EndpointPolicy: endpoint traffic policy resource under a custom routing listener.
This parameter is valid only when the Action parameter is set to CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型，取值：
Listener：监听资源。
IpSet：加速地域资源。
EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。
ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。
Endpoint：终端节点资源。
EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。
EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。
仅在Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the managed policy action is managed. Valid values:
true: The managed policy action is managed. The user cannot perform the operation specified by Action on the managed instance.
false: The managed policy action is not managed. The user can perform the operation specified by Action on the managed instance
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：
true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。
false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

State.description_en:
The status of the listener.

configuring: The listener is being configured.

init: The listener is being initialized.

updating: The listener is being updated.

deleting: The listener is being deleted
State.description_zh:
监听的状态。

configuring：配置中。

init：初始化。

updating：更新中。

deleting：删除中

Type.description_en:
The routing type of the listener.

Standard: Intelligent routing type.

CustomRouting: Custom routing type
Type.description_zh:
监听的路由类型。

Standard：智能路由类型。

CustomRouting：自定义路由类型

XForwardedForGaApEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `GA-AP` header is used to retrieve the acceleration area information.
true: Yes.
false: No.

Only HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
XForwardedForGaApEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`GA-AP`字段获取加速地域信息。
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数

XForwardedForGaIdEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `GA-ID` header is used to retrieve the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance ID.
true: Yes.
false: No.

Only HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
XForwardedForGaIdEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`GA-ID`头字段获取全球加速实例ID。
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数

XForwardedForPortEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `GA-X-Forward-Port` header is used to retrieve the listener port of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.
true: Yes.
false: No.

Only HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
XForwardedForPortEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`GA-X-Forward-Port`字段获取全球加速实例的监听端口。
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数

XForwardedForProtoEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `GA-X-Forward-Proto` header is used to retrieve the listener protocol of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.
true: Yes.
false: No.

Only HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
XForwardedForProtoEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`GA-X-Forward-Proto`字段获取全球加速实例的监听协议。
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数

XRealIpEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the `X-Real-IP` header is used to retrieve the real client IP address.
true: Yes.
false: No.

Only HTTP and HTTPS listeners support this parameter
XRealIpEnabled.description_zh:
是否通过`X-Real-IP`字段获取真实的客户端IP。
true：是。
false：否。

仅HTTP和HTTPS监听支持此参数
